# Glossary

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Browser Runtime | Browser runtime environment that executes page JavaScript, cookies, sessions, and network requests |
| Machine | Node that hosts the remote browser runtime environment |
| Browser | Sa2web browser instance |
| SaaS Site | External business site accessed from the user frontend |
| Inner Site | Entry point to an internal enterprise business system |
| Workspace | Business entry that fixes a site account, browser environment, and configuration |
| Group | Authorization unit that combines users, sites, workspaces, permissions, and networks in batches |
| Collaboration Link | Controlled access link for collaboration or temporary users |
| Encrypted URL | Capability that hides the origin address shown in the user frontend |
| Replay | Recording and replay of remote browsing access |
| MCP | Model Context Protocol |
| `@sa2web/mcp` | Sa2web MCP / CLI npm package |
| `sa2` | Sa2web recommended remote browser CLI |
| Passkey | Passwordless authentication method based on standards such as WebAuthn |
